label: MiniMax H3 Image
description: MiniMax H3 Image: edit one frame with a plate connected, or text to image with nothing connected. Up to 3 reference images. Output: ACES2065-1 EXR at plate size (or the project format).
usage: One node, two modes: with a plate connected it edits that frame; with nothing in the plate input it is text to image at the project format's aspect and size.
Pick the frame with 'frame' (Set to current frame) - only that frame is sent.
The plate is <Picture 1>, ref2-ref4 are <Picture 2>-<Picture 4>. With no plate, the connected refs are numbered from <Picture 1>.

Keep 'refine prompt' on: H3 Image wants a long, complete English description, and the official enhancer writes it from your short instruction (it looks at the plate and refs). 'Run enhancer only' shows its rewrite first.
'megapixels' is the size H3 works at (4-16; best around 16, soft under 4). The result is scaled back to plate size. Lower it first if you run out of VRAM.
H3 redraws the whole frame - there is no mask and the original pixels aren't kept. Comp the edit back over the plate only where it changed.
Crop: tick 'crop' and move the box in the viewer to send only that area (more detail on small fixes).
Press Render in ComfyUI; Bring in output reads the result under the node.

highlights: 'roll off' (default) compresses values above 1 going in: highlights return approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed and new near-whites come back hot. 'clip' cuts at 1 and keeps shadows open.
License (checked 2026-11): MiniMax-H3-Image Community License. Above USD 1M annual revenue (you and affiliates), or for hosted services, you need written permission from MiniMax.

output.tooltip: H3 Image makes a display-referred image at its work size; it is scaled back to plate size and comes back to scene-linear through the 'highlights' choice. Comp an edit back only where it changed.

knobs.name: prompt
knobs.label: prompt
knobs.tooltip: Edit: the instruction, e.g. 'Replace the car in <Picture 1> with ...'. Text to image (no plate): what to make. The plate is <Picture 1>; ref2-ref4 are <Picture 2>-<Picture 4>. With 'refine prompt' off, write the full long description yourself.

knobs.name: refine_prompt
knobs.label: refine prompt
knobs.tooltip: On (default): the official H3 Image prompt enhancer turns the prompt into the long description H3 needs (slower, much better on short prompts). Off: the prompt goes in as typed.

knobs.name: megapixels
knobs.label: megapixels
knobs.tooltip: Size H3 works at, with the plate's aspect (the project format's with no plate), a multiple of 32; scaled back to plate size after. 4-20 MP is its working range, best around 16; below 4 it gets soft. Higher = more detail, more VRAM and time.

knobs.name: highlights
knobs.label: highlights
knobs.tooltip: roll off (default): the plate and refs go in through ACES Output - sRGB and the result comes back through its inverse, so highlights are compressed instead of cut. Highlights come back approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed, and new near-white pixels come back hot. clip: values above 1 reach the model as 1 (colorimetric), shadows stay open. Comp only the changed area.

knobs.name: steps
knobs.label: steps
knobs.tooltip: 6 is the official value (the model is distilled for it).

knobs.name: enhancer_mp
knobs.label: enhancer megapixels
knobs.tooltip: Size of the plate and refs the prompt enhancer looks at (H3 itself still gets them at 'megapixels'). Each is scaled to this size; every 32x32 pixels is one token for the enhancer to read.
